headline: Anthropic's internal Claude use now costs more than total employee salaries
body: Anthropic revealed that its own internal consumption of Claude AI at retail pricing now exceeds the company's total employee compensation, signaling massive scale in AI infrastructure costs. The disclosure emerged as Anthropic prepares for its IPO with reported Q3 revenue of $17B and $895B in revised spending commitments. For healthcare organizations evaluating large language models, this metric exposes the true operational cost of deploying enterprise-grade AI systems at scale, which directly impacts ROI calculations for clinical NLP, documentation automation, and care coordination tools. Healthcare CIOs and consulting teams should factor infrastructure and token costs into vendor comparisons rather than focusing solely on per-license pricing. The capital intensity now visible at Anthropic suggests that healthcare AI projects requiring sustained, high-volume inference will face significant ongoing consumption costs regardless of deployment model.
